name: ASTRAZENECA DL-,25 SP.ADR
summary: AstraZeneca is a global, science-led biopharmaceutical company that discovers, develops, and commercializes prescription medicines, primarily for the treatment of diseases in three therapy areas - Oncology, Cardiovascular, Renal & Metabolism, and Respiratory & Immunology. The company is headquartered in Cambridge, United Kingdom. AstraZeneca has a broad portfolio of products and a strong pipeline of potential new medicines.
